summary: Bumped MCP server to v1.31.0 (Minor: new repo-namespaced storage feature + migration, backward-compatible). Bumped orchestrator to v0.21.0 (Minor: path derivation updated). Root changelog updated to v1.27.0. npm run sync-version confirmed v1.30.2 → v1.31.0 in package.json. TypeScript build clean. No migration guide required (auto-migration handles existing projects at server startup).

comments.note: MCP server v1.31.0 Minor bump rationale: storage layout change is a new feature (repo-namespaced directories), existing projects auto-migrate on startup, MCP tool API surface unchanged, and bare-slug resolution remains backward-compatible.
Orchestrator v0.21.0 Minor bump: _derive_slug_dir() and cli.py log copy path now use namespaced {repo_name}/{slug}/ layout. Internal change, no public API surface affected.

Known follow-up debt (out of scope): gui/api.ts handleListDialogues, handleGetDialogueFile, handleListChunks, handleGetChunkFile still use non-namespaced join(ledgerRoot, slug, ...) paths. Flagged by Reviewer (WP-011 comment). Should be addressed in a follow-up WP.
